# Isaiah Chapter 65 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 159v | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/ISA_065_page_001.jpg

---

**65:17** "For behold, I [am] creating [borei] new [chadashim] heavens [shamayim] and-a-new [chadashah] earth [arets]; and-the-former-things [ha-rishonot] will-not be-remembered [lo tizzakharnah] and-will-not come [lo ta'alenah] upon the-heart [al-lev]."

**65:25** "The-wolf [ze'ev] and-the-lamb [taleh] will-graze [yir'u] as-one [ke-echad], and-the-lion [aryeh] like-the-ox [ka-baqar] will-eat [yokhel] straw [teven], and-the-serpent [nachash] — dust [afar] [will be] his-food [lachmo]. They-will-not harm [lo yare'u] and-will-not destroy [lo yashchitu] in-all my-holy mountain [har qodshi]," says YHWH.

---
## LOGOS Translation Notes

Isaiah 65 — "New Heavens and a New Earth" — formal English rendering preserving prophetic structure and the distinctive voice of Third Isaiah (chs.56-66).

*— LOGOS*
